Single-Prediction Collapsed Agent Model

Single-prediction collapsed Bayesian agent model.

This is a further reduction of agent_model.MultivariateAgentModel for the case where the agent observes a single scalar prediction pred_o for a single observed feature vector X_o. Under independent Gaussian priors on the coordinates of the coefficient vectors N_b and N_d, those vectors are marginalized analytically, so the only non-auxiliary latent variables left are N_E and the population-level parameters.

The reduced-plate auxiliary variables (s, W, g, h) of the multivariate model are replaced by two scalar auxiliaries (R, T), constant in both the plate size n and the number of covariates k. Conditional on (R, T, N_E, the population-level parameters, and X_o), the observed prediction is Gaussian:

\(Pred^o \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{red}, V_{red})\)

with

\(\mu_{red} = c + (m_b + N_E m_d) S_o\)

\(V_{red} = Q_o (v_b + 2 N_E v_{bd} + N_E^2 v_d) + \tau^2 (1/n + R/T)\),

where the cross term vanishes (\(v_{bd} = 0\)) under the independent coefficient priors assumed by this class. Because PyMC does not provide a native non-central chi-squared distribution, R is built through the equivalent central-chi-squared (Cochran) construction

\(G_R \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1)\), \(Z_R \sim \chi^2_{k-1}\), \(R := (\Delta_X + G_R / \sqrt{n})^2 + Z_R / n\),

with \(\Delta_X^2 := (X^o - \vec{\alpha}_{X\mu})^\top D_X^{-2} (X^o - \vec{\alpha}_{X\mu})\) and the convention \(\chi^2_0 = 0\) when k = 1. The orthogonal rotation behind Cochran’s theorem concentrates the non-centrality in a single coordinate, so the model samples three scalar primitive variables (G_R, Z_R, T) regardless of k and n.

Since the CATE depends only on N_E, marginalizing N_b and N_d loses no information relevant to the decision rule. For the agent-side predictive quantities (predictive summaries of X, A, and Y, and expected do(A) outcomes) the marginalized coefficient vectors are recovered when needed: from their priors for prior predictive sampling, and from their conditional Gaussian given (N_E, R, T, the population-level parameters, and pred_o) for posterior predictive sampling. The derivation is in the “Single-prediction collapsed reduction” document of the paper derivations.

class single_prediction_collapsed_agent_model.SinglePredictionCollapsedAgentModel(n_covariates, plate_size, prior_parameters=None)[source]

Bases: object

Bayesian agent model for the single-prediction collapsed likelihood.

The class assumes independent Gaussian priors for the coordinates of N_b and N_d. These vectors are marginalized analytically and are not sampled by PyMC, so the latent variables of the model are the population-level parameters, N_E, and the two scalar auxiliaries (R, T) of the collapsed likelihood.

The model always assumes an OLS predictive model with intercept, and is specific to a single observed prediction: it does not extend, in this form, to more than one prediction. Because the CATE depends only on N_E, the prior and posterior CATE are obtained directly from N_E. The agent-side predictive summaries and expected-outcome helpers of the multivariate model are still provided: the marginalized coefficient vectors are recovered from their priors for prior predictive sampling, and from their conditional Gaussian given (N_E, R, T, the population-level parameters, and pred_o) for posterior predictive sampling.

Parameters:

  • n_covariates (int) – Number of covariates k (dimension of X).

  • plate_size (int) – Size of the plate (number of i.i.d. samples used to train the predictive model). Must be larger than n_covariates.

  • prior_parameters (dict) – Dictionary with parameters for the prior distributions. If None, defaults are used. Vector-valued entries accept a scalar (broadcast to length k) or an array of length k.

Returns:

None

classmethod load_agent_model(file_name='single_prediction_collapsed_agent_model', folder='./saved_models/')[source]

Load a saved single-prediction collapsed agent model.

The configuration is loaded with joblib and the PyMC model is reconstructed by re-running __init__. The trace and prior samples are loaded from their NetCDF files if present.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Base filename without extension. Expects to find {file_name}.joblib and, optionally, {file_name}_trace.nc and {file_name}_prior_samples.nc.

  • folder (str) – Folder the model is saved in.

Returns:

The loaded agent model.

Return type:

SinglePredictionCollapsedAgentModel

sample(X_o, pred_o, draws=1000, tune=1000, target_accept=0.85, chains=4, max_treedepth=15, init='jitter+adapt_diag', rng=None)[source]

Sample from the posterior given observed data. Stores the latest trace in self.

Parameters:

  • X_o (np.ndarray) – Observed feature vector of length k.

  • pred_o (float) – Observed scalar prediction for X_o.

  • draws (int) – Size of sample to draw from the posterior.

  • tune (int) – Number of tuning (warmup) iterations.

  • target_accept (float) – Target acceptance probability for NUTS.

  • chains (int) – Number of chains to sample.

  • max_treedepth (int) – Maximum tree depth for NUTS.

  • init (str) – Initialization method passed to pm.sample.

  • rng – Seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility.

Returns:

None

sample_posterior_predictive(rng=None)[source]

This method generates a sample from the agent’s posterior beliefs. Using the trace stored in self, it reconstructs the marginalized coefficient vectors from their conditional Gaussian for each posterior draw, replaces the parameter values in the internal predictive SCM, and draws a posterior predictive sample from it.

Parameters:

rng – Seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility.

Returns:

One (X, A, Y, mu_Y_cond, std_Y_cond) sample per draw.

Return type:

list

sample_posterior_predictive_CATE(A1_treatment, A0_treatment)[source]

This method returns a sample from the posterior CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation. Under the collapsed model the CATE depends only on N_E, so it is the posterior draws of N_E multiplied by A1_treatment - A0_treatment.

Parameters:

  • A1_treatment (float) – Dosage value of higher dose treatment.

  • A0_treatment (float) – Dosage value of lower dose treatment.

Returns:

(CATE_samples, CATE_mean, CATE_std).

Return type:

tuple

sample_prior_predictive(draws=1000, rng=None)[source]

Method for sampling from the distribution based on the agent’s prior beliefs. For every draw of the predictive parameters from the prior, the marginalized coefficient vectors are drawn from their priors, the internal predictive SCM is updated, and one (X, A, Y) sample is generated from it.

Parameters:

  • draws (int) – Size of sample to draw.

  • rng – Seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility.

Returns:

One [X, A, Y] triple per draw.

Return type:

list

sample_prior_predictive_CATE(A1_treatment, A0_treatment, draws=1000, rng=None)[source]

This method returns a sample from the prior CATE-distribution, and its sample mean and standard deviation. Under the collapsed model the CATE depends only on N_E, so it is obtained from the prior draws of N_E multiplied by A1_treatment - A0_treatment. It does not require conditioning on X. The prior draws are shared with the other prior predictive methods.

Parameters:

  • A1_treatment (float) – Dosage value of higher dose treatment.

  • A0_treatment (float) – Dosage value of lower dose treatment.

  • draws (int) – Size of sample to draw if prior samples are drawn here.

  • rng – Seed or initialized random number generator for reproducibility.

Returns:

(CATE_samples, CATE_mean, CATE_std).

Return type:

tuple

save_agent_model(file_name='single_prediction_collapsed_agent_model', folder='./saved_models/')[source]

Save the agent model configuration and available samples.

The trace and prior samples are written separately with ArviZ (NetCDF), and the rest of the configuration is pickled with joblib. The PyMC model, trace, and prior samples are temporarily detached before pickling and restored afterwards.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Base filename without extension. Creates {file_name}.joblib and, when available, {file_name}_trace.nc and {file_name}_prior_samples.nc.

  • folder (str) – Folder to save the model into.
